summary: GH Research PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of a registered underwritten offering of 6,527,779 ordinary shares at $18.00 per share, raising approximately $111.2 million in net proceeds. The offering was conducted under an underwriting agreement with Stifel and Cantor Fitzgerald as representatives. Proceeds will be used for R&D, clinical development, pre-commercialization, and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
